info.title: WWHD Deadzone Tool
info.author: Tot_sr
info.description: Save and restore WWHD deadzone profiles
info.details:
Aroma plugin by Tot_sr for capturing and saving native GamePad and original Wii U Pro Controller calibration/deadzone settings in eight named profiles. The selected profile is automatically reapplied on supported game launches and maintained during play. Supports European and North American Wind Waker HD, TWWHD-GZ and the TWWHD Randomizer channel.

Requires Aroma Beta 26 or newer; update Aroma and its modules before installing. Extract the release ZIP's wiiu folder to SD root and fully restart the Wii U. Open L + D-pad Down + Minus, then WWHD Deadzone Tool, select a profile and use Capture Deadzones. Do not install multiple plugin copies.

Hardware restoration verified on GZ and the randomizer; vanilla European testing was reported. Vanilla North American WWHD has not been separately hardware-tested. Captures existing calibration, not an automated drift test. Plugin code is MIT; WUPS retains LGPL-3.0.

AI use: Co-written with AI. AI also used for: icon/banner art, description text.

changelog: 1.2.0 adds North American WWHD and the TWWHD Randomizer channel. Existing named profiles are retained and the selected calibration is shared across supported titles. Saved EUR/GZ GamePad and Pro Controller calibration was verified restoring in the randomizer.
